description: Reports a product problem or gap in redditapis.com to its team, through a local draft queue. action "draft" (the default) writes a report to a queue on this machine and sends nothing; it makes no network call. action "list" returns the pending drafts with their ids. action "send" posts the named draft ids to POST /feedback (free, not metered) and returns a server id per report. action "discard" drops the named drafts. The queue holds at most 10 drafts; a draft past that is refused. A draft takes `type`, a one-line `title` (at most 120 characters), `details` (at most 8000 characters) and optional `area` and `evidence`; evidence keys left out (tool, endpoint, HTTP status, request id) are filled from the last failing call in this session, and the MCP version and client name are attached to every report.

action.description: "draft" (default) queues a new report locally and sends nothing. "list" returns the pending drafts with their ids. "send" posts the drafts named in `ids` to redditapis.com. "discard" drops the drafts named in `ids`.

area.description: Optional. The endpoint or feature the report is about, e.g. "posts/comments" or "monitoring". At most 80 characters.

details.description: Required for a draft. At most 8000 characters: three labelled bullets, What happened, Repro, Evidence, optionally preceded by a one-line summary of the goal. No quotes of the conversation.

evidence.description: Optional identifiers, {tool, endpoint, status, request_id}, at most 4096 bytes serialized. Keys left out are filled from the last failing call in this session; mcp_version and client are attached to every report.

ids.description: For action "send" or "discard": the draft ids to act on, as returned by action "list".

title.description: Required for a draft. One line, at most 120 characters, naming the tool or endpoint and the defect, e.g. "GET /api/reddit/comments returns 502 when the post is deleted".

type.description: Required for a draft. "bug": a tool or endpoint misbehaved. "idea": a change that would have made the task easier. "missing_capability": a needed capability that no tool provides.

name: reddit_feedback_send
